example_sentences_in_english: Add a little salt to the food.
A tiny doubt arose in his mind.
history: Referenced in Rabindranath Tagore's works, implying fragility or sensitivity: 'একটুকু ছোঁয়া লাগে একটুকু কথা শুনি'
note: Often used to denote something minimal that can have an impact, drawing from literary sensitivity in Bengali culture.
